title: fix(scripts): decouple the clean-census self-test control from the live tree
body:
Fixes #19299
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`scripts/check-tenant-audit-census.mjs`'s self-test built two synthetic
censuses for the `censusRefusals` control battery, `refuse` and
`refuseUndefended`, meant to make the self-test independent of whatever
today's tree happens to hold. `refuse` overrode two of the three refusal
inputs (`unledgered`, `staleLedgerRows`) but let the third,
`undefendedSubtractions`, leak through from the live `census` built by
`runCensus()`. `refuseUndefended` already zeroed all three explicitly for
the same reason.

One-line fix: `refuse` now also passes `undefendedSubtractions: []`,
matching `refuseUndefended`.

## Why

With `undefendedSubtractions` leaking through, the control `a census with
neither an unplaceable site nor a stale row is NOT a finding` (`refuse([],
[])`) stopped being independent of the live tree for the
`type-text-not-round-trippable` class: if today's tree carries any
undefended round-trip subtraction, that control fails and CI reds on the
self-test line before the bare gate's own located verdict ever prints —
the real finding would then be visible only inside the control's own
failure text, mislabelled as an instrument failure. This is a diagnosis-
only fix: `censusRefusals` itself is unchanged, and the bare gate's exit
code is unaffected either way.

## Risk & rollback (风险与代价)

Blast radius is the self-test function only (`selfTest()`); the change
does not touch `censusRefusals`, `runCensus()`, or anything the bare gate
(non-self-test invocation) reads. Rollback is reverting this one line.

On this tree, the fixture receiver the card's `type-text-not-round-
trippable` example describes is absent, so `--self-test` reads **27/27
both before and after** — this PR restores the invariant the gate's own
docblock already declares, it does not flip a currently-red control to
green. Verified at HEAD `eb52f396f`:

```
$ node scripts/check-tenant-audit-census.mjs --self-test
✓ tenant-audit-census self-test: 59 cases pass (...)
✓ check-tenant-audit-census self-test: 27 cases pass (...)
$ node scripts/check-tenant-audit-census.mjs
✓ check-tenant-audit-census: OK -- 227 write call sites certified (...)
```

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:`scripts/check-tenant-audit-census.mjs` 自测里的 `refuse` 合成对照
函数补上了 `undefendedSubtractions: []`,与 `refuseUndefended` 已有的写法对齐——
之前它会漏过第三个字段,任其从活树读入的真实 census 里泄漏进来。

**为什么改**:卡片(#19299)指出这个不对称让"干净普查不应被判定为发现"这条自测
对照,不再像文档承诺的那样与当天的树无关——一旦树上出现某个不可回读类型的未防
御减法,这条本该恒真的对照会失败,而 CI 在 `--self-test` 这一行就先红了、真正的
裸门禁结论根本打印不出来,真发现被自测失败的措辞盖住,看起来像工具坏了。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:改动只影响自测,不影响 `censusRefusals` 本体与裸门禁的
退出码;本仓当前树上触发条件(fixture receiver)不存在,所以自测在改动前后都是
27/27——这次改动是补齐一个还没现形的漏洞,不是把一条已经红了的检查修绿。回滚只
需还原这一行。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:review 这一行 diff;确认 `skip-changeset` label 是否需要复核(本 PR
只改 `scripts/`,未发布到任何包的 `files[]`)。
